text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit!
Full steam ahead!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Victory!
This week's Pre-Fi was simply magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It happens every time, but watching Purify
gets my blood pumping!
I feel like fighting right this second too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Like after watching a movie or reading a book,
you get inspired and want to try doing it yourself."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What?! Call me a copycat all you want!
If I wanna do it, I'll give it a shot—that's my spirit!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
New experiences can sometimes be
the catalyst for discovering a whole new side of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to get this restless body
moving, I say~!
DOOOORYAAAAAHHHH~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, that 'Princess Sky Step'
move from PreFai was so amazing..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"With a single stride, she glided forward effortlessly,
as if she were running on air..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because of this incident, Nishino Flower's running took on a sharper edge from that day forward.
